args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick heads-up on a label mix-up for Pellow Home Living (PHL):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The saved report probably needs its label updated so it matches the new name.

Could you check which account or report this affects and whether the label should be corrected?

Thanks,
Sofia
